job: Scroll a row of cards sideways with snapping and arrows.
purpose: A horizontal row of cards that snaps, for "Featured" and "Recommended". The two arrow buttons disable at either end and the whole control disappears when everything fits. fd:change reports start, middle or end.
useWhen: A short shelf of featured or recommended cards sits above a longer catalogue.
Space is tight and a grid would push the page down.

avoidWhen.when: The cards are the main content and people compare them.
The items are pages in a sequence.
The items are tabs or filters.
A data set with many columns.

states.name: at start
states.how: the previous button is disabled; fd:change value "start"

states.name: at end
states.how: the next button is disabled; fd:change value "end"

states.name: fits
states.how: the nav is hidden when nothing overflows

keyboard.does: Moves through cards and the arrow buttons.
On an arrow button, scrolls one card width.
